basis: The observer's observed=true assignment occurs only inside one current DOM sample where the requested button is uniquely found in the active Scrape pane, passes visibility checks, is disabled, and contains the mode-specific busy label.
Mutation records only increment a diagnostic count; no historical disabled/text replay can set observed=true.
A same-turn disabled Capturing transition that ends before callback delivery remains observed=false and text=null, even when mutation records exist.
Foreign-pane, inline-hidden, stylesheet-hidden, and hidden or transparent ancestor busy transitions do not create a positive verdict after the button returns idle and visible.
A current, visible, disabled Scrolling button passes in an independent deep-mode probe; Capturing on that button or Scrolling without disabled remains false.

focused_verification.independent_probe: Three happy-dom deep-mode cases: live disabled Scrolling=true; disabled Capturing=false; enabled Scrolling=false.

native_limit: No browser or hosted native acceptance was run in this peer lane. Direct DOM sampling does not prove a painted frame. The exact original Store 0.2.205 run observed no disabled busy sample; product cause and original unthrottled acceptance remain unresolved. The proposed constrained-CPU diagnostic is only a handoff, not implementation or native evidence.
scope: Independent review and lightweight tests only; no product, observer, acceptance, or guard changes.
